source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 1 (PDF 1-21), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Periodic Table and Periodic Properties) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The periodic table of elements is rightly referred to as the:
(Periodic table ko sahi taur par kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter periodic table ko "Symbol of Chemistry" kehta hai, kyun ke yeh chemical ilm ka ahem zariya hai (1.1).

book_ref.quote: refer to the periodic table of elements as the

blocks.prompt:
2 The modern periodic table provides the foundation for understanding how many elements?
(Modern periodic table kitne elements ko samajhne ki buniyaad deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maujooda table 118 elements aur un ki properties (khasusiyaat) samajhne ki buniyaad hai (1.1).

book_ref.quote: It provides the foundation for comprehending 118 elements and their properties

blocks.prompt:
3 By 1700 A.D., the number of elements recognised was only:
(1700 A.D. tak sirf kitne elements pehchane gaye thay?)
blocks.explanation: 1700 A.D. tak sirf 12 elements (maslan gold, silver, copper) pehchane gaye thay (1.1).

book_ref.quote: By 1700 A.D., only 12 elements

blocks.prompt:
4 Which one of the following was NOT among the 12 elements recognised by 1700 A.D.?
(In mein se kaun sa element 1700 A.D. tak pehchane gaye 12 elements mein shamil NAHI tha?)
blocks.explanation: Woh 12 elements gold, silver, copper, iron, lead, tin, mercury, phosphorus, sulfur, carbon, zinc aur arsenic thay; sodium list mein nahi (1.1).

book_ref.quote: Gold, Silver, Copper, Iron, Lead, Tin, Mercury, Phosphorus, Sulfur, Carbon, Zinc, and Arsenic

blocks.prompt:
5 Up to the end of the 18th century, Antoine Lavoisier tried to classify the known elements as:
(18vi sadi ke aakhir tak Antoine Lavoisier ne maloom elements ko kis tarah taqseem karne ki koshish ki?)

options.text: s, p, d and f blocks

blocks.explanation: Lavoisier ne maloom elements ko metals aur nonmetals mein taqseem karne ki koshish ki (1.1).

book_ref.quote: Antoine Lavoisier attempted to classify known elements as metals and nonmetals

blocks.prompt:
6 Döbereiner grouped the elements into triads in the year:
(Döbereiner ne elements ko triads mein kis saal taqseem kiya?)
blocks.explanation: 1829 mein Döbereiner ne elements ko triads (teen ka group) mein rakha jin ki properties milti julti thin (1.1).

book_ref.quote: In 1829, Döbereiner grouped the elements into triads

blocks.prompt:
7 In a Döbereiner triad, the atomic weight of the middle element is:
(Döbereiner triad mein darmiyani element ka atomic weight kya hota hai?)

options.text: baqi do ki average (ausat) ke qareeb

blocks.explanation: Döbereiner ne dekha ke darmiyani element ka atomic weight baqi do ki average (ausat) ke qareeb hota hai (1.1).

book_ref.quote: noting that the atomic weight of the middle element was roughly the average of the other two

blocks.prompt:
8 Three elements with similar properties form a triad. The first and third have atomic masses 40 and 137. The triad rule predicts the atomic mass of the middle element to be about:
(Milti julti properties wale teen elements triad banate hain. Pehle aur teesre ka atomic mass 40 aur 137 hai. Triad rule ke mutabiq darmiyani element ka atomic mass taqreeban kitna hoga?)

book_ref.quote: the middle one is the average of the other two, (7 + 39) ÷ 2 = 23

blocks.prompt:
9 John Newlands observed periodicity among how many known elements?
(John Newlands ne kitne maloom elements mein periodicity (dohraao) dekhi?)
blocks.explanation: 1864 mein Newlands ne 62 maloom elements mein periodicity dekhi (1.1).

book_ref.quote: first time observed periodicity in the 62 known elements

blocks.prompt:
10 When elements were arranged by increasing atomic masses, Newlands found that the first element resembled in properties:
(Atomic masses ki barhti tarteeb mein rakhne par Newlands ne dekha ke pehla element properties mein kis se milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Newlands ne elements aise rakhe ke har aathwan (8th) element pehle se milta tha (1.1).

book_ref.quote: every eighth element resembled the first element in properties

blocks.prompt:
11 In 1869, Mendeleev arranged 63 elements in vertical columns in the order of increasing:
(1869 mein Mendeleev ne 63 elements ko vertical columns mein kis cheez ki barhti tarteeb se rakha?)
blocks.explanation: Mendeleev ne 63 elements ko barhte atomic mass ke hisaab se aath vertical columns mein rakha (1.1).

book_ref.quote: arranged 63 elements into eight vertical columns by increasing atomic mass

blocks.prompt:
12 The success of Mendeleev's table was mainly due to:
(Mendeleev ke table ki kamyabi ki asal wajah kya thi?)

options.text: elements ko atomic numbers se tarteeb dena
na-daryaft elements ke liye khaali jagah aur un ki properties ki pesh-goi (prediction)
elements ko s, p, d, f blocks mein rakhna

blocks.explanation: Us ne na-daryaft elements ke liye khaali jagah chhori aur un ki properties ki pesh-goi ki jo sahi sabit hui (1.1).

book_ref.quote: The success of his table was hidden in leaving gaps for undiscovered elements

blocks.prompt:
13 Lothar Meyer's curves were obtained by plotting a graph between:
(Lothar Meyer ke curves kin do cheezon ke graph se bane?)
blocks.explanation: Lothar Meyer ne atomic weights aur atomic volumes ka graph banaya; curves mein periodicity nazar aayi (1.1).

book_ref.quote: plotting a graph between the atomic weights and atomic volumes of elements

blocks.prompt:
14 Moseley determined the exact atomic numbers of the known elements by using:
(Moseley ne maloom elements ke durust atomic numbers kis tareeqe se maloom kiye?)
blocks.explanation: 1913 mein Moseley ne X-ray emission se durust atomic numbers maloom kiye (1.1).

book_ref.quote: Moseley determined the exact atomic numbers of known elements using X-ray emission

blocks.prompt:
15 Moseley removed the flaws of Mendeleev's table by arranging the elements by:
(Moseley ne Mendeleev ke table ki khamiyan kis tarteeb se door keen?)

options.text: atomic masses ki bajaye atomic numbers se
atomic numbers ki bajaye atomic masses se
atomic masses ki bajaye atomic volumes se
atomic numbers ki bajaye densities se

blocks.explanation: Moseley ne elements ko atomic masses ki bajaye atomic numbers se tarteeb diya aur periodic law badla (1.1).

book_ref.quote: arranging the elements by atomic numbers instead of atomic masses

blocks.prompt:
16 Whose table was the first most notable effort in the classification of elements?
(Elements ki taqseem mein pehli sab se numayan koshish kis ka table tha?)
blocks.explanation: Mendeleev ne atomic masses se elements tarteeb diye; us ka table pehli numayan koshish thi (1.1).

book_ref.quote: his table was the first most notable effort in the classification of elements

blocks.text: 1.2 Modern periodic table: features and significance

blocks.prompt:
17 In the modern periodic table, the 118 elements are placed in ascending order of their:
(Modern periodic table mein 118 elements kis cheez ki barhti tarteeb mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Is waqt 118 elements barhte atomic numbers ki tarteeb mein hain (1.2).

book_ref.quote: grouped in the table in ascending order of their respective atomic numbers

blocks.prompt:
18 The number of horizontal rows (periods) in the modern periodic table is:
(Modern periodic table mein horizontal rows (periods) kitni hain?)
blocks.explanation: Saat (7) horizontal rows hain jinhein periods kehte hain (1.2).

book_ref.quote: There are seven horizontal rows called periods

blocks.prompt:
19 The number of vertical columns (groups) in the modern periodic table is:
(Modern periodic table mein vertical columns (groups) kitne hain?)
blocks.explanation: Modern table mein atharah (18) vertical columns hain jinhein groups kehte hain (1.2).

book_ref.quote: eighteen vertical columns called groups

blocks.prompt:
20 In older versions of the periodic table, the 8 vertical groups were divided into:
(Purane periodic table mein 8 vertical groups kis tarah taqseem thay?)
blocks.explanation: Purane tables mein 8 vertical groups thay jo aath A-groups aur das B-groups mein taqseem thay (1.2).

book_ref.quote: Eight A-Groups and Ten B-Groups

blocks.prompt:
21 Elements of the same group show similar chemical properties because they have the same:
(Aik hi group ke elements ki chemical properties kyun milti hain? Un mein kya cheez aik jaisi hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group ke elements mein valence electrons (bahar wale electrons) ki tadaad aik jaisi hoti hai, is liye chemical properties milti hain (1.2).

book_ref.quote: because they have the same number of valence electrons

blocks.prompt:
22 From top to bottom in a group, the physical properties of elements:
(Group mein oopar se neeche physical properties kaisi hoti hain?)

options.text: har element par achanak badalti hain
har aathwen element ke baad dohrati hain

blocks.explanation: Group mein oopar se neeche physical properties mein ahista ahista tabdeeli aati hai (1.2).

book_ref.quote: they show a gradual change in physical properties from top to bottom in a group

blocks.prompt:
23 Metals are elements which tend to:
(Metals woh elements hain jo kya karte hain?)

options.text: electrons le kar negative ions banate hain
electrons kho kar positive ions banate hain
na electrons khote hain na lete hain

blocks.explanation: Metals electrons kho kar positive ions (musbat ions) banate hain, maslan iron aur copper (1.3).

book_ref.quote: Metals are elements which tend to lose electrons to form positive ions

blocks.prompt:
24 Which one of the following is a non-metal?
(In mein se kaun sa non-metal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Non-metals electrons le kar negative ions banate hain; misalein chlorine, sulfur, phosphorus (1.3).

book_ref.quote: The examples are chlorine, sulfur and phosphorous

blocks.prompt:
25 The "stair-step line" on the periodic table begins at:
(Periodic table par "stair-step line" (seerhi numa lakeer) kahan se shuru hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stair-step line boron se shuru ho kar polonium tak jaati hai (1.3).

book_ref.quote: The line begins at boron (B) and extends down to polonium (Po)

blocks.prompt:
26 Which one of the following is a metalloid?
(In mein se kaun sa metalloid hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stair-step line ke saath Si, Ge, As, Sb aur Te metalloids hain (1.3).

book_ref.quote: including Si, Ge, As, Sb and Te

blocks.prompt:
27 Elements that show properties of both metals and nonmetals are also termed:
(Jo elements metals aur nonmetals dono ki properties dikhate hain unhein aur kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Line ke bilkul daayen elements metalloids ya semimetals kehlate hain (1.3).

book_ref.quote: are termed as metalloids or semimetals

blocks.prompt:
28 Which element is the exception to the rule that elements to the left of the stair-step line are metals?
(Kaun sa element is qaida ka istisna (exception) hai ke stair-step line ke baayen elements metals hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen, pehla element, istisna (exception) hai (1.3).

book_ref.quote: The exception is hydrogen, the first element on the periodic table

blocks.prompt:
29 Elements are classified into blocks on the basis of:
(Elements ko blocks mein kis buniyaad par taqseem kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Blocks us subshell par mabni hain jis mein valence electrons hote hain (1.4).

book_ref.quote: based on the subshells containing their valence electrons

blocks.prompt:
30 The elements of the first two groups belong to the:
(Pehle do groups ke elements kis block mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Un ke valence electrons s subshell mein hain, is liye woh s-block mein hain (1.4).

book_ref.quote: placing these elements in the s-block

blocks.prompt:
31 Transition elements belong to the:
(Transition elements kis block mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Transition elements d-block mein hain (1.4).

book_ref.quote: transition elements belong to the d-block

blocks.prompt:
32 The lanthanides and actinides, the two series at the bottom of the table, are:
(Table ke neeche wali do series, lanthanides aur actinides, kis block mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Lanthanides aur actinides f-block elements hain (1.4).

book_ref.quote: are categorized as f-block elements

blocks.prompt:
33 The elements of groups 13 to 18, including the gases of the last group, belong to the:
(Group 13 se 18 tak ke elements, aakhri group ki gases samait, kis block mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Group 13 se 18 ke baqi elements p-block mein hain (1.4).

book_ref.quote: including the inert gases in the last group, belong to the p-block

blocks.prompt:
34 An element family is:
(Element family kya hai?)

options.text: aik jaise atomic mass wale elements
mushtarak properties wale elements ka majmooa

blocks.explanation: Element family aise elements ka majmooa hai jin ki properties mushtarak (common) hon (1.5).

book_ref.quote: An element family is a set of elements sharing common properties

blocks.prompt:
35 Group 1 elements are called alkali metals because they:
(Group 1 ke elements ko alkali metals kyun kehte hain?)

options.text: zyada tar zameen mein milte hain
metals ke saath salts banate hain
un ka koi valence electron nahi
paani se react kar ke alkalis banate hain

blocks.explanation: Group 1 ke elements paani se react kar ke alkalis banate hain, is liye alkali metals (1.5).

book_ref.quote: because they produce alkalis when they react with water

blocks.prompt:
36 Which one of the following is NOT a property of alkali metals?
(In mein se kaun si alkali metals ki property NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkali metals ka aik valence electron, kam density, nisbatan kam melting point aur kam ionization energy hoti hai (1.5).

book_ref.quote: Alkali metals are characterized by one valence electron, low densities

blocks.prompt:
37 Alkaline earth metals are divalent because they have:
(Alkaline earth metals divalent (do grafti) kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Group 2 ke elements ke valence shell mein do electrons hain, is liye divalent hain (1.5).

book_ref.quote: These elements have two electrons in their valence shell, making them divalent

blocks.prompt:
38 Compared with alkali metals, alkaline earth metals are:
(Alkali metals ke muqable mein alkaline earth metals kaise hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alkaline earth metals, alkali metals se zyada sakht aur zyada dense hain (1.5).

book_ref.quote: harder and denser than alkali metals

blocks.prompt:
39 The largest family of elements in the middle of the periodic table is the:
(Periodic table ke darmiyan elements ki sab se badi family kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transition metals table ke darmiyan sab se badi family hain (1.5).

book_ref.quote: The transition metals make up the largest family of elements

blocks.prompt:
40 Which property is typical of transition elements?
(Kaun si property transition elements ki khasoosiyat hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transition elements ke melting point aur density zyada hote hain, oxidation states badalti hain, aur aksar rangeen compounds bante hain (1.5).

book_ref.quote: high melting points, high density, and variable oxidation states

blocks.prompt:
41 Group 16 elements are called chalcogens because:
(Group 16 ke elements ko chalcogens kyun kehte hain?)

options.text: copper (chalkos) ki zyada tar ores oxides ya sulfides hain
alkali metals se salts banate hain

blocks.explanation: Copper (Greek chalkos) ki zyada tar ores (kachi dhaat) oxides ya sulfides hain, is liye naam chalcogens (1.5).

book_ref.quote: because most ores of copper (Greek chalkos) are oxides or sulfides

blocks.prompt:
42 In group 16, the non-metals are:
(Group 16 mein non-metals kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Group 16 mein oxygen aur sulphur non-metals hain (1.5).

book_ref.quote: oxygen & sulphur are non-metals

blocks.prompt:
43 The element at the bottom of group 16 is:
(Group 16 ke bilkul neeche kaun sa element hai?)
blocks.explanation: Element 116, livermorium, group 16 ke neeche hai aur metal hai (1.5).

book_ref.quote: is a misprint for livermorium (Lv, element 116)

blocks.prompt:
44 The term "halogen" means:
(Lafz "halogen" ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Halogens alkali aur alkaline earth metals se mil kar mustahkam halide salts banate hain; halogen ka matlab "salt-former" (namak banane wala) (1.5).

book_ref.quote: these elements easily react with alkali metals and alkaline earth metals to form stable halide salts

blocks.prompt:
45 Halogens complete their outermost shell by:
(Halogens apna bahar wala shell kaise mukammal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Halogens aasani se aik electron le kar bahar wala shell mukammal karte hain (1.5).

book_ref.quote: Halogens can easily accept one electron to complete their outermost shell

blocks.prompt:
46 Halogens are highly reactive nonmetals having:
(Halogens bohat reactive nonmetals hain jin ki kya cheez zyada hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Halogens bohat reactive nonmetals hain aur un ki electron affinity zyada hoti hai (1.5).

book_ref.quote: Halogens are highly reactive nonmetals with high electron affinities

blocks.prompt:
47 Noble gases exist in nature as:
(Noble gases fitrat mein kis shakal mein hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Noble gases monoatomic (aik atom wali) hain (1.5).

book_ref.quote: These elements are monoatomic in nature

blocks.prompt:
48 Which compound shows that noble gases are not completely unreactive?
(Kaun sa compound dikhata hai ke noble gases bilkul bhi ghair-reactive nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Xenon ke compounds bante hain, maslan XePtF₆; is liye "inert gases" ka naam "noble gases" rakha gaya (1.5).

book_ref.quote: xenon hexafluoroplatinate (XePtF₆)

blocks.prompt:
49 Noble gases are almost entirely unreactive under normal conditions because they have:
(Aam haalat mein noble gases taqreeban bilkul react kyun nahi karti?)
blocks.explanation: Un ka bahar wala shell mukammal (stable configuration) hai, is liye taqreeban react nahi karti (1.5).

book_ref.quote: Due to their stable electron configuration (complete outermost shell)

blocks.prompt:
50 Which element belongs to the halogen family?
(Kaun sa element halogen family mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Halogens: F, Cl, Br, I, At aur Ts (1.5).

book_ref.quote: Halogens (F, Cl, Br, I, At, Ts)

blocks.prompt:
51 Which one of the following is a noble gas?
(In mein se kaun si noble gas hai?)
blocks.explanation: Noble gases: He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn aur Og (1.5).

book_ref.quote: Noble gases (He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn, Og)

blocks.prompt:
52 Which element belongs to the alkaline earth metals?
(Kaun sa element alkaline earth metals mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Calcium alkaline earth metals mein shamil hai (1.5).

book_ref.quote: Alkaline earth metals (Be, Mg, Ca, Ba, R.)

blocks.prompt:
53 Which one of the following is listed among the transition metals?
(In mein se kaun sa transition metals mein shamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transition metals: Sc, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn (1.5).

book_ref.quote: Transition metals (Sc, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn)

blocks.prompt:
54 The period number of an element indicates:
(Kisi element ka period number kya batata hai?)

options.text: electron shells ki tadaad (principal quantum number n)

blocks.explanation: Period number principal quantum number (n) yani nucleus ke gird shells ki tadaad batata hai (1.6).

book_ref.quote: The period number indicates the principal quantum number (n)

blocks.prompt:
55 The subshell in which the valence electrons of an element are found depends on the element's:
(Kisi element ke valence electrons kis subshell mein hain, yeh kis cheez par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Valence electrons ka subshell element ke block (azimuthal quantum number) par munhasir hai (1.6).

book_ref.quote: The specific subshell where the valence electrons are found

blocks.prompt:
56 An element is in period 3, group 1 (s-block). Its electronic configuration is:
(Aik element period 3, group 1 (s-block) mein hai. Us ki electronic configuration kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Period 3 yani teen shells; group 1 s-block yani 3s mein aik valence electron: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s¹ (1.6).

book_ref.quote: an element X in the 3rd period has three electron shells

blocks.prompt:
57 An element has the configuration 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p¹. Its position in the periodic table is:
(Aik element ki configuration 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p¹ hai. Periodic table mein us ki jagah kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Teen shells yani period 3; 3s² 3p¹ mein teen valence electrons yani group 13 (1.6).

book_ref.quote: the element X belongs to group 13 of periodic table so it has 3 valence electrons

blocks.prompt:
58 For an s-block element in group 2, the group number tells us that it has:
(Group 2 ke s-block element ke liye group number kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group number valence electrons ki tadaad batata hai; group 2 yani bahar wale shell mein do electrons (1.6).

book_ref.quote: the group number indicates the number of valence electrons

blocks.prompt:
59 According to the Modern Periodic Law, the properties of elements are periodic functions of their:
(Modern Periodic Law ke mutabiq elements ki properties kis cheez ke periodic functions hain?)
blocks.explanation: Modern Periodic Law: physical aur chemical properties atomic numbers ke periodic functions hain (1.7).

book_ref.quote: The physical and chemical properties of elements are periodic functions of their atomic numbers.

blocks.prompt:
60 The atomic number of an element corresponds to the number of:
(Atomic number kis cheez ki tadaad ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Atomic number atom mein protons ki tadaad ke barabar hai (1.7).

book_ref.quote: The atomic number corresponds to the number of protons in an atom

blocks.prompt:
61 When elements are arranged by increasing atomic number, which element shows many properties similar to lithium?
(Barhte atomic number ki tarteeb mein kaun sa element lithium se milti julti properties dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sodium, potassium aur cesium lithium ke group mein hain, is liye properties milti hain (1.7).

book_ref.quote: sodium, potassium, and cesium exhibit many physical and chemical characteristics similar to lithium

blocks.prompt:
62 The atomic radius is:
(Atomic radius kya hai?)

options.text: do aik jaise bonded atoms ke darmiyan faasle ka aadha
do bonded atoms ke darmiyan poora faasla
do bonded atoms ke faasle ka do guna

blocks.explanation: Atomic radius aapas mein bonded do aik jaise atoms ke darmiyan faasle ka aadha hai (1.7.1).

book_ref.quote: It is half of the distance between two identical atoms bonded together

blocks.prompt:
63 The distance between the nuclei of two identical atoms bonded together is 228 pm. The atomic radius is:
(Aapas mein bonded do aik jaise atoms ke nuclei ka faasla 228 pm hai. Atomic radius kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Atomic radius = faasle ka aadha = 228 ÷ 2 = 114 pm (1.7.1).

book_ref.quote: The atomic radius is a measure of the size of an atom

blocks.prompt:
64 Atomic radius is typically measured in:
(Atomic radius aam taur par kis unit mein naapa jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Atomic radius picometres (pm) ya angstroms (Å) mein naapa jata hai (1.7.1).

book_ref.quote: typically measured in picometers (pm) or Angstroms (Å)

blocks.prompt:
65 The atomic radius of an element can vary depending upon:
(Kisi element ka atomic radius kis cheez par badal sakta hai?)

options.text: bond ki qisam (covalent, metallic, van der Waals)

blocks.explanation: Atomic radius bond ki qisam (covalent, metallic, van der Waals) ya atom ki haalat se badal sakta hai (1.7.1).

book_ref.quote: depending on the type of bond (covalent, metallic & van der Waals forces)

blocks.prompt:
66 Which one of the following is NOT listed as a factor affecting atomic radius?
(In mein se kaun sa atomic radius par asar karne wala factor NAHI bataya gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Factors yeh hain: atomic number, effective nuclear charge aur andar wale electrons ka shielding effect (1.7.1).

book_ref.quote: The factors affecting the atomic radius are: atomic number, effective nuclear charge and shielding effect of inner electrons

blocks.prompt:
67 Atomic radius increases down a group mainly because:
(Group mein neeche jaate hue atomic radius kyun barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group mein neeche naye shells judte hain; zyada shielding nuclear charge ke izafe par haavi ho jati hai (1.7.1).

book_ref.quote: because additional electron shells are added

blocks.prompt:
68 Atomic radius decreases across a period from left to right because:
(Period mein baayen se daayen atomic radius kyun kam hota hai?)

options.text: barhta nuclear charge electron cloud ko qareeb kheenchta hai

blocks.explanation: Period mein barhta nuclear charge electron cloud ko qareeb kheench leta hai (1.7.1).

book_ref.quote: due to increasing nuclear charge, which pulls the electron cloud closer

blocks.prompt:
69 The ionic radius is a measure of the size of:
(Ionic radius kis cheez ke size ka paimana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ionic radius crystal lattice mein ion ke size ka paimana hai (1.7.2).

book_ref.quote: The ionic radius is a measure of the size of an ion in a crystal lattice

blocks.prompt:
70 A positive ion is smaller than its neutral atom because the loss of electrons:
(Positive ion apne neutral atom se chhota kyun hota hai? Electrons khone se kya hota hai?)

options.text: repulsion kam hota hai aur baqi electrons qareeb kheench liye jaate hain

blocks.explanation: Electrons khone se repulsion (dhakka) kam hota hai; baqi electrons nucleus ke qareeb aa jaate hain (1.7.2).

book_ref.quote: the loss of electrons reduces electronic repulsion

blocks.prompt:
71 When an atom gains electrons to form an anion, it becomes larger because:
(Atom electrons le kar anion bane to bada kyun ho jata hai?)

options.text: repulsion barhta hai aur electron cloud phail jata hai

blocks.explanation: Naye electrons repulsion barhate hain; nucleus ki kashish kam ho kar electron cloud phail jata hai (1.7.2).

book_ref.quote: the addition of electrons increases electronic repulsion

blocks.prompt:
72 Which statement about sizes is correct?
(Size ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Cl⁻ Cl atom se bada hai
Na⁺ Na atom se bada hai
Cl⁻ aur Cl atom barabar hain
Na⁺ aur Na atom barabar hain

blocks.explanation: Anion neutral atom se bada aur cation chhota hota hai, is liye Cl⁻ Cl se bada hai (1.7.2).

book_ref.quote: it generally becomes larger than the neutral atom

blocks.prompt:

book_ref.quote: Silicon dioxide is acidic oxide as it can react with bases

blocks.prompt:
140 The balanced equation for the reaction of P₂O₃ with water is:
(P₂O₃ aur paani ke reaction ki balanced equation kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2 P aur 6 O barabar: P₂O₃(s) + 3H₂O(l) → 2H₃PO₃(aq) (1.9.1).

book_ref.quote: The balanced equation is P₂O₃(s) + 3H₂O(l) → 2H₃PO₃(aq)

blocks.prompt:
141 Sulphur dioxide dissolves in water to form:
(Sulphur dioxide paani mein ghul kar kya banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: SO₂(g) + H₂O(l) → H₂SO₃(aq); acidic oxide paani se acid deta hai (1.9.1).

book_ref.quote: An acidic oxide is an oxide that when combined with water gives off an acid

blocks.prompt:
142 From SO₂ + 2NaOH → Na₂SO₃ + H₂O, the moles of NaOH needed to react with 0.3 mol of SO₂ are:
(SO₂ + 2NaOH → Na₂SO₃ + H₂O se, 0.3 mol SO₂ ke liye kitne mole NaOH chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: 1 mol SO₂ ko 2 mol NaOH, is liye 0.3 × 2 = 0.6 mol NaOH (1.9.1).

blocks.prompt:
143 Neutral chlorides dissolve in water to give a solution with pH:
(Neutral chlorides paani mein ghul kar kis pH ka solution dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Neutral chlorides ka solution neutral hota hai, pH 7 ke qareeb (1.9.2).

book_ref.quote: produce a neutral solution with a pH close to 7

blocks.prompt:
144 When NaCl dissolves, its ions become surrounded by water molecules. This process is called:
(NaCl ghulne par us ke ions paani ke molecules se ghir jaate hain. Is amal ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Paani ke molecules se ghire ions hydrated ions hain; yeh amal hydration hai (1.9.2).

book_ref.quote: These ions are now known as hydrated ions and this process is known as hydration

blocks.prompt:
145 The pH of the solution of MgCl₂ in water given in the chapter is:
(Chapter mein MgCl₂ ke paani mein solution ka pH kitna diya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: MgCl₂(s) → Mg²⁺(aq) + 2Cl⁻(aq), pH = 6.5, jab ke NaCl ka pH 7 (1.9.2).

book_ref.quote: chlorides of sodium and magnesium do not react with water

blocks.prompt:
146 From aluminium to sulphur in period 3, the chlorides react with water to give solutions that are:
(Period 3 mein aluminium se sulphur tak chlorides paani se react kar ke kaisa solution dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh chlorides hydrolysis karte hain aur solution acidic ho jata hai, pH 7 se kam (1.9.2).

book_ref.quote: all chlorides react with water to make acidic solution with pH less than 7

blocks.prompt:
147 AlCl₃ solution in water is acidic because the hydrated Al³⁺ ion:
(AlCl₃ ka paani mein solution acidic kyun hai? Hydrated Al³⁺ ion kya karta hai?)

options.text: paani ke molecule se H⁺ ion alag karwata hai
paani se koi tealluq nahi rakhta

blocks.explanation: Hydrated Al³⁺ paani ke molecule se H⁺ alag karwata hai (hydrolysis): AlCl₃ + 3H₂O → Al(OH)₃ + 3HCl (1.9.2).

book_ref.quote: Al³⁺ ion is hydrated and causes a water molecule to lose an H⁺ ion

blocks.prompt:
148 From SiCl₄ + 2H₂O → SiO₂ + 4HCl, the moles of HCl formed from 0.25 mol of SiCl₄ are:
(SiCl₄ + 2H₂O → SiO₂ + 4HCl se, 0.25 mol SiCl₄ se kitne mole HCl banenge?)
blocks.explanation: 1 mol SiCl₄ se 4 mol HCl, is liye 0.25 × 4 = 1.0 mol HCl (1.9.2).

blocks.text: 1.9 Trends in bonding in the oxides and chlorides of period 3

blocks.prompt:
149 Oxides of groups 1, 2 and 3 of period 3, such as Na₂O, exist as:
(Period 3 ke group 1, 2 aur 3 ke oxides, maslan Na₂O, kis shakal mein hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Un mein ionic character zyada hai aur woh mazboot electrostatic forces wale giant ionic lattices hain (1.9).

book_ref.quote: These oxides exist as giant ionic lattices with strong electrostatic forces

blocks.prompt:
150 Sulphur dioxide (SO₂) exists as:
(Sulphur dioxide (SO₂) kis shakal mein hota hai?)

options.text: kamzor intermolecular forces wale covalent molecules

blocks.explanation: SO₂ jaise oxides kamzor intermolecular forces wale covalent molecules hain (1.9).

book_ref.quote: These oxides exist as covalent molecules with weak intermolecular forces

blocks.prompt:
151 Across period 3, the covalent character of chlorides increases because:
(Period 3 mein chlorides ka covalent character kyun barhta hai?)

options.text: chlorine aur doosre atom ki electronegativity ka farq kam hota hai

blocks.explanation: Halogen aur doosre atom ki electronegativity ka farq kam hone se covalent character barhta hai (1.9).

book_ref.quote: The covalent character in chlorides increases due to decrease in difference of electronegativity

blocks.prompt:
152 Which one of the following chlorides is covalent?
(In mein se kaun sa chloride covalent hai?)
blocks.explanation: Baad wale groups ke chlorides, maslan PCl₅, covalent hain; NaCl zyada tar ionic (1.9).

book_ref.quote: Chlorides of elements from group 4, 5, 6 and 7 (e.g., PCl₅) are covalent

blocks.text: 1.10 Variation in oxidation number in oxides and chlorides

blocks.prompt:
153 The oxidation number of an atom is:
(Atom ka oxidation number kya hai?)

options.text: molecule ya ion mein atom par formal charge

blocks.explanation: Oxidation number molecule ya ion mein atom par formal charge hai (1.10).

book_ref.quote: The oxidation number of an atom is the formal charge on that atom in a molecule or ion

blocks.prompt:
154 Another name for oxidation number is:
(Oxidation number ka doosra naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxidation number ko oxidation state bhi kehte hain (1.10).

book_ref.quote: The oxidation number is also referred to as the oxidation state

blocks.prompt:
155 In an ionic compound such as MgCl₂, the oxidation number of magnesium is:
(MgCl₂ jaise ionic compound mein magnesium ka oxidation number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ionic compounds mein oxidation number ion ka charge hai; Mg²⁺ yani +2 (1.10).

book_ref.quote: In ionic compounds the oxidation number of an atom is defined as the charge which appears on the ions

blocks.prompt:
156 The oxidation number of a period 3 element in its oxide or chloride is always positive because:
(Period 3 ke element ka oxidation number us ke oxide ya chloride mein hamesha positive kyun hota hai?)

options.text: oxygen aur chlorine in elements se zyada electronegative hain
oxygen aur chlorine kam electronegative hain

blocks.explanation: O aur Cl period 3 ke tamam elements se zyada electronegative hain, is liye period 3 ka element positive (1.10).

book_ref.quote: is always positive because oxygen and chlorine are more electronegative than any of these elements

blocks.prompt:
157 In the oxides of period 3 given in Table 1.2, the highest oxidation number is:
(Table 1.2 ke period 3 oxides mein sab se zyada oxidation number kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxides mein oxidation number Na ke +1 se S (SO₃) ke +6 tak barhta hai (1.10).

book_ref.quote: In the oxides, the oxidation number increases from +1 in Na to +6 in S

blocks.prompt:
158 In the chlorides of period 3 given in Table 1.2, the highest oxidation number is:
(Table 1.2 ke period 3 chlorides mein sab se zyada oxidation number kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorides mein oxidation number Na ke +1 se P (PCl₅) ke +5 tak barhta hai (1.10).

book_ref.quote: In chlorides, the oxidation number increases from +1 in Na to +5 in P

blocks.prompt:
159 Taking each Cl as −1, the oxidation number of sulphur in SCl₂ is:
(Har Cl ko −1 le kar SCl₂ mein sulphur ka oxidation number kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: It is +2: each Cl is -1 and the molecule is neutral

blocks.prompt:
160 Taking O as −2, the oxidation number of phosphorus in P₄O₆ is:
(O ko −2 le kar P₄O₆ mein phosphorus ka oxidation number kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Table 1.2: Oxidation Numbers in Oxides and Chlorides of 3rd Period elements

blocks.prompt:
161 Phosphorus and sulphur can expand their octet by exciting electrons into empty:
(Phosphorus aur sulphur apna octet kin khaali orbitals mein electrons bhej kar barha sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: P aur S khaali 3d orbitals mein electrons bhej kar kai oxidation numbers dikhate hain (1.10).

book_ref.quote: because they can expand their octet by exciting electrons into empty 3d orbitals

blocks.prompt:
162 In SO₂, the number of electrons of sulphur used for bonding is:
(SO₂ mein sulphur ke kitne electrons bonding mein istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: SO₂ mein sirf chaar electrons bonding mein lagte hain, is liye S +4; SO₃ mein chhe (+6) (1.10).

book_ref.quote: sulfur has an oxidation number of +4 because only four electrons are used for bonding
